data.name: ARO: Tales In The Dome
data.detailed_description:
This game is in early development, and current visuals do not represent the final quality.

Born Under the Dome

With the birth of the protagonist Aro, the world is covered by a massive dome. No one knows where it came from, and the appearance of the sky has gradually faded from memory.

Aro was adopted by the Dark Elemental Spirit and learned how to control and harness dark elemental energy. However, as he grew, the Dark Elemental Spirit began to carry out her plan of revenge.

Embarking on his journey of exploration, he will traverse dangerous forests and forbidden zones, confront unknown threats, and gradually uncover the truth about his own origins, the mysteries of the dome, and the conspiracies behind the world.

Every choice could change his fate, and multiple endings await brave players to discover.

Core Gameplay

  • Smooth Skill Combos: Whether on the ground or in the air, you can flexibly perform basic combos and elemental skill combinations, experiencing fast-paced, rhythm-filled combat.

  • Variety of Elemental Skills: Master different elemental powers to add strategy to both combat and exploration. Each elemental skill opens up entirely new possibilities.

  • Combo Fusion: Combine normal attacks with elemental skills to create more powerful new abilities, offering rich combat strategies and satisfying gameplay.

  • Innovative Exploration Mechanics: Use action techniques cleverly to reach hidden areas, uncover secrets, and solve puzzles deep in the map.

  • Challenge and Growth: Defeat mutated creatures and powerful bosses, collect items and upgrades, and gradually build Aro’s unique skill system.

  • More Features in Development: The full version will add more content and mechanics, further enriching exploration and combat experiences.

World and Conspiracies

Under the dome, mutation and conspiracy intertwine.

Explore underground areas, forests, and the skies, unlock hidden maps, and face powerful enemies. Each battle and discovery will reveal more secrets.

Only through brave exploration can Aro find his own path—and possibly change the fate of the entire world.

data.short_description: "ARO: Tales in the Dome" is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure game. Play as Aro and explore an elemental world sealed beneath the dome. As the journey unfolds, uncover the hidden conspiracy and face the truth about the world, the dome, and yourself.
